DATA SELECTOR CIRCUITS
The data selector circuits have seven inputs and one output.
DISCUSSION
A1 and A2 are the address inputs that select which data input is placed on the output.
00 selects input A, 01 selects input B, 10 selects input C and 11 selects input D.
The EN input enables inputs A through D. A low signal is required for selection. If the EN input is high, the output will be
low, regardless of any other input levels......
The output contains single data from A through D or multiplexed data from a combination of A through D.
What is the output of the data selector circuit?
First, find the address and determine which input is selected. Then look at the selected input level.
TRY AGAIN!
ADDRESSING DATA - Providing that EN is low, an address input of 00 selects data input A. 01 selects B, 10 selects C and 11 selects D.
What is the output of this data selector circuit?
If the EN input is high, the output will be low, regardless of any other input levels.....
TRY AGAIN!
Multiplexing is accomplished by addressing each input during one time period.
During T1, inputs A through D are selected and placed on the output.

The counter addresses input D. Touch NEXT to observe the operation.
The counter addresses input D. Touch NEXT to observe the operation.
At time T2, the counter is set to 00 and the data during T2 is placed on the output in the same manner.
This selector circuit consists of three inverters, four 4-input AND gates and one 4-input OR gate......
A low ENABLE input places a high on each AND gate.
An address of 00 places two highs on AND gate 1.
With three high inputs to gate 1, the output is the level of input A.
AND gates 2, 3 and 4 all have low inputs from the address.m
An address of 01 places two highs on AND gate 2.
With three high inputs to gate 2, the output is the level of input B.
AND gates 1, 3 and 4 all have low inputs from the address.W
Select the AND gate that is enabled with an address of 11?
An address of 11 places a low from A1 inverter to gates 1 and 3 and a low from A2 inverter to gates 1 and 2.
TRY AGAIN!
Select the AND gate that is enabled with an address of 10?
An address of 10 places a low from A1 to gates 2 and 4 and from A2 inverter to gates 1 and 2.
TRY AGAIN!
